nodes.title: Decode · v1.1 continuous duration (max ~10 s in one piece)
ArtofTomworks · LTX 2.5 Simple [GLOBAL]
widgets_values:
Image-to-video with LTX 2.5. Two-stage generation with latent spatial upscaling, audio and live preview.

LoRAs start OFF. ArtofTomworks appears only in the workflow, never on the video.

608 × 1088 · 4 s · 24 FPS

nodes.title: PREVIEW · TIME · ETA
widgets_values: Model Preview Override shows partial frames during generation. The preview does not represent final video quality. If missing, check KJNodes and refresh the ComfyUI page.

nodes.title: QUICK START · OUTPUT
widgets_values:
1. Replace the first frame and enter your scene prompt.
2. Set duration, FPS and output size.
3. Optionally enable an LTX-compatible LoRA.
4. Run the graph. Find the result in SaveVideo and ComfyUI output/video.

The second sampling pass and latent upscaler add spatial detail; they do not increase FPS.

nodes.title: REQUIREMENTS AND HELP
widgets_values:
Required models: LTX 2.5 FP8 diffusion model, Gemma 3 12B text encoder for LTX 2.5, LTX 2.5 video VAE and audio VAE, LTX 2.5 latent spatial upscaler 2×, TAE LTX (tiny VAE for live preview). Pick your own file names in the loader nodes if they differ.
Custom nodes: rgthree-comfy (Power LoRA Loader), ComfyUI-KJNodes (live preview, Tiny VAE loader).

ComfyUI: https://docs.comfy.org/installation/install_custom_node
rgthree: https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy
KJNodes: https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
LTX 2.5: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5
